mapper.insert: insert into SR03 (seq, seq01, parents, text, userid, regdate) values (SEQ_SR03.NEXTVAL, #{seq01}, #{parents}, #{text}, #{userid}, #{regdate})
mapper.select: SELECT /*+ LEADING(T R) USE_NL(R) */ T.seq, T.seq01, T.text, T.userid, T.regdate, T.good, NVL(R.reply, 0) AS reply FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT /*+ INDEX(SR03 IDX_SR03_1) */ ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY seq) AS rn, seq, seq01, text, userid, regdate, good FROM SR03 WHERE seq01 = #{seq01} AND parents = 0 ) WHERE rn > #{startRownum} AND rn <= #{endRownum} ) T LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT seq01, parents, COUNT(*) AS reply FROM SR03 WHERE seq01 = #{seq01} GROUP BY seq01, parents ) R ON T.seq01 = R.seq01 AND T.seq = R.parents

select /*+ INDEX_DESC(SR03 IDX_SR03_1)*/ rownum as rown, seq as seq, seq01 as seq01, text as text, userid as userid, regdate as regdate, good as good from SR03 where seq01 = #{seq01} and parents = #{parents}
select /*+ INDEX_FFS(SR03 IDX_SR03_1)*/ count(*) as totCnt from SR03 where seq01 = #{seq01} and parents = 0
select seq as seq, userid as userid from SR03 where seq = #{seq}
